# Diamonds Drill Clothing

> Expérience minière — Quebec-inspired mining streetwear from the drift.

Diamonds Drill Clothing is a workwear-inspired streetwear brand rooted in
Quebec mining culture, built by and for the underground crew. The tagline on
the site is in Quebec French: « Expérience minière » — the site opens with a
"Descendre dans la mine" button and drops the visitor into a full-screen
canvas mining experience before reaching the shop.

Our signature slogan is « Quand elle résiste, nous on insiste ! » —
"When it resists, we insist!" It is not a slogan, it is a full work shift
(c'est pas un slogan, c'est un quart de travail). The brand speaks to drillers,
muckers and the whole underground gang (toute la gang du fond).

## Collection

Five designs, each with its own story, cut as black T-shirt or black hoodie:

- **Diamonds Drill — Flagship** — « Quand elle résiste, nous on insiste ! » /
  "When it resists, we insist!" The brand manifesto. For those who actually
  know the rock. Not a slogan — a full work shift. For drillers, muckers,
  the whole underground crew.
- **Muckeurs — Rose** (Muckers — Pink) — for the women of the underground,
  running the scoop on 12-hour shifts. Pink is not a concession, it's a
  flag.
- **Muckeurs — Jaune** (Muckers — Yellow) — for the mucking crew: cleaning
  the face, loading, moving the mine forward one bucket at a time.
- **Conventional Mining** — the conventional cycle spelled out: muck,
  drill, blast — repeat. Trade pride for the jackleg and drift crews.
- **Surface Drilling** (FR name on site: Forage de surface) — surface
  diamond drilling: the drill rig, the crew, the terrain.

## Shop

- Five designs × two cuts, always black: T-shirt noir and Hoodie noir.
- Product format, always: small logo on the heart side in front, medium
  visual on the back — toujours.
- Personalization: your name on the heart side, +8 CAD.
- Prices: coming soon (bientôt disponible).
- Payment: Stripe checkout will be activated once the client's Stripe
  account is open.

## Interactive Experience

The site homepage is an interactive mine experience rendered on a full-screen
HTML canvas (game-style). Visitors press "Descendre dans la mine" (descend
into the mine), drill into ore veins (quartz, diamond, gold) and unlock the
collections — a section is called « Filon débloqué — Collection Foreur ».
The experience copy on the site is in Quebec French.
